title: Special Requirements for Blank Walls
previewText: Where visual mitigation elements are required on a blank wall along the ground floor level street wall in accordance with other streetscape provisions in this Resolution, such blank wall shall be covered by one or more of the following mitigation elements set forth in this Section.
